title: A surprising discovery
instructions: Wpisz w każdą lukę dokładnie jedno słowo. Skróty typu don't liczą się jako dwa słowa, więc nie są poprawną odpowiedzią. Każda luka to 1 punkt.
text: When archaeologists began digging on the site, they had {{1}} idea what they would find. At first, nothing seemed out of the ordinary, but {{2}} the end of the second week they had uncovered the remains of a Roman villa. {{3}} had such a well-preserved building been found in the region before. The team worked day and night {{4}} order to finish before the winter weather arrived. {{5}} was particularly exciting was a floor decorated with a detailed mosaic. Experts believe it may {{6}} been made for a wealthy merchant. The site is now protected, and {{7}} the excavation is complete, it will be opened to the public. Local officials hope it will attract visitors from all {{8}} the country.

gaps.explanation: Have no idea = nie mieć pojęcia.
By the end of = do końca (Past Perfect).
Inwersja po wyrażeniu przeczącym: Never had such… been found.
May have been made – modalny w przeszłości, strona bierna.
Once / when the excavation is complete – czas teraźniejszy o przyszłości.
From all over the country = z całego kraju.
